# Office of Kaiju Affairs

> The national authority for kaiju corridor management: permits, damage compensation, and evacuation services for residents of zones 1-5.

## Pages
- [Authentication](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/getting-started-authentication): Authenticate API requests with a bearer API key.
- [Changelog](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/changelog): Recent changes to the KMP API and platform.
- [Concepts](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/concepts): The three core building blocks of KMP: pipelines, connectors, and events.
- [Connectors](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/concepts-connectors): What a connector is in KMP: a pre-built integration to a source or destination system, with its own auth and catalog of built-in types.
- [Events](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/concepts-events): What an event is in KMP: the atomic unit of data moving through a pipeline, plus the platform's own lifecycle events.
- [Glossary](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/glossary): Definitions for KMP's core terms, each linking to its full explanation.
- [Installation](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/getting-started-installation): Install the KMP SDK or start calling the REST API directly.
- [Kaiju Monitoring Platform Docs](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/platform): Everything you need to build data pipelines on the Kaiju Monitoring Platform.
- [Migration guide (v1 → v2)](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/migration-guide-v1-to-v2): Move an existing v1 integration to the v2 API: cursor pagination, webhooks, and the new error shape.
- [Office of Kaiju Affairs](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/index): The national authority for kaiju corridor management: permits, damage compensation, and evacuation services for residents of zones 1-5.
- [Pipelines](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/concepts-pipelines): What a pipeline is in KMP: a named, versioned workflow that moves data from a source connector through transform steps to a destination.
- [Quickstart](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/getting-started-quickstart): Go from zero to a running pipeline in five minutes.
- [Release notes archive](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/release-notes-archive): Older v1-era release notes, superseded by the current changelog.
- [Security & compliance overview](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/security-and-compliance): How KMP handles data in transit and at rest, credential storage, and compliance posture.
- [Support / Contact](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/support): How to reach the KMP team for support, sales, or security reports.
- [Troubleshooting / FAQ](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/troubleshooting): Common problems and fixes across pipelines, connectors, and webhooks.

## About
- [About the Office](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/about/index): Mandate, structure and history of the Office of Kaiju Affairs under the Special Corridors Act.

## Open Data
- [Open Data — Service Register](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/agent-data/index): Machine-readable register of Office services, eligibility rules, forms and offices.

## apis
- [API Reference](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/apis/index): The KMP v2 REST API: pipelines, connectors, events, webhooks, and rate limits.
- [Connectors endpoint](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/apis/connectors): Create, list, and rotate credentials for connectors via the v2 REST API.
- [Error responses](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/apis/error-responses): The v2 API's error response shape, and the breaking change from v1's bare error strings.
- [Events endpoint](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/apis/events): Query and replay events that have flowed through a pipeline via the v2 REST API.
- [Pipelines endpoint](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/apis/pipelines): Create, list, and manage pipelines via the v2 REST API.
- [Rate limits](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/apis/rate-limits): Standard-tier rate limits and the v2 API's cursor-based pagination envelope.
- [Webhooks endpoint](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/apis/webhooks): Subscribe to Kaiju Monitoring Platform lifecycle events over outbound HTTP via the v2 REST API.

## Claims
- [Claim Eligibility](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/claims/eligibility/index): Zone rules, insurance offsets and the hardship supplement for kaiju damage compensation claims.
- [Claim Fee Schedule](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/claims/fees/index): The claim assessment fee, refund rules, and waivers for kaiju damage compensation.
- [Claims](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/claims/index): Damage claims administered by the Office of Kaiju Affairs, deadlines, and how to begin.
- [Claims FAQ](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/claims/faq/index): Common questions about kaiju damage compensation claims, including fee waivers for repeat claimants.
- [How to File a Claim](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/claims/how-to-file/index): The five steps of a kaiju damage compensation claim, from incident report to determination.
- [Kaiju Damage Compensation](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/claims/damage-compensation/index): Compensation for structural, contents and business-interruption damage caused by kaiju activity inside zones 3, 4 and 5.

## Contact
- [Contact](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/contact/index): How to contact the Office of Kaiju Affairs: offices, phone lines and correspondence.

## Evacuation
- [Evacuation](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/evacuation/index): Designated evacuation routes, assembly points, and assisted-evacuation registration for zones 3, 4 and 5.
- [Zone 4 Evacuation](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/evacuation/zone-4/index): Evacuation routes 4A and 4B, assembly points and guidance for Zone 4 residents.

## guides
- [Building your first pipeline](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/guides/building-your-first-pipeline): Create a source connector, a destination connector, and the pipeline that connects them, end to end.
- [Connecting a data source](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/guides/connecting-a-data-source): Choose the right connector type and authentication method for a new data source.
- [Guides](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/guides/index): Task-oriented walkthroughs for building, connecting, and operating KMP pipelines.
- [Handling errors & retries](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/guides/handling-errors-and-retries): How KMP retries failed events, when they're dead-lettered, and how to replay them.
- [Monitoring & alerts](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/guides/monitoring-and-alerts): Watch pipeline health and get notified of failures via webhooks before they become incidents.
- [Rate limiting cookbook](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/guides/rate-limiting-cookbook): Practical patterns for handling API rate limits.
- [Scheduling & triggers](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/guides/scheduling-and-triggers): Run a pipeline on a cron schedule or trigger it directly from incoming events.

## Regional Offices
- [Kanto North Regional Office](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/offices/kanto-north/index): Address, hours, phone and services for the Kanto North Regional Office, serving zones 3 and 4.
- [Regional Offices](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/offices/index): The three regional offices of the Office of Kaiju Affairs, their zones, services and hours.

## Permits
- [Apply — Proximity Construction Permit](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/permits/proximity/apply/index): Online application form for the kaiju-proximity construction permit.
- [Kaiju-Proximity Construction Permit](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/permits/proximity/index): Permission to build, extend or structurally alter a structure within 1,000 metres of a designated kaiju corridor centreline.
- [Permit Requirements](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/permits/proximity/requirements/index): Documents, fees and deadlines for the kaiju-proximity construction permit.
- [Permits](https://office-of-kaiju-affairs.vercel.app/permits/index): Permits administered by the Office of Kaiju Affairs, including the kaiju-proximity construction permit.
